description: Source code for MCP9808 temperature sensor driver in Zephyr RTOS, including register read/write functions, initialization, and sensor data fetching.

methods.name: mcp9808_reg_read
methods.description: Reads a 16-bit register from the MCP9808 sensor via I2C.

methods.name: mcp9808_reg_write_16bit
methods.description: Writes a 16-bit value to a register on the MCP9808 sensor via I2C.

methods.name: mcp9808_reg_write_8bit
methods.description: Writes an 8-bit value to a register on the MCP9808 sensor via I2C.

methods.name: mcp9808_init
methods.description: Initializes the MCP9808 sensor device, sets resolution, and configures interrupts if enabled.
